claims.atomic_statement: TP53 mutation is a major adverse prognostic factor under intensive chemoimmunotherapy.
MIPI53 separates newly diagnosed patients into markedly different survival groups.
Other molecular lesions may refine risk beyond TP53/Ki-67/blastoid status.
At 4.5 years, adding ASCT to the TRIANGLE ibrutinib regimen did not improve failure-free survival.
TRIANGLE’s ibrutinib-containing arms improved OS versus control but increased infections.
Ibrutinib–rituximab improved PFS over the pooled ENRICH immunochemotherapy control.
ENRICH proves superiority over bendamustine–rituximab specifically.
ECHO improved PFS but had not demonstrated an OS advantage.
BOVen is active in untreated TP53-mutated MCL and permits MRD-based cessation.
claims.status: Supported as feasibility/activity; comparative superiority unproven

claims.atomic_statement: FIL_V-RBAC proves venetoclax overcomes high-risk biology.
MRD-guided treatment cessation is feasible in selected frontline and R/R cohorts.
MRD negativity justifies omission of rituximab maintenance.
Pirtobrutinib has meaningful activity after cBTKi exposure.
At median follow-up of 67.8 months in ZUMA-2 cohort 1, median duration of response was 36.5 months.
Liso-cel is active after BTKi exposure with low grade ≥3 CRS but material neurological toxicity/cytopenia.
Real-world CAR-T effectiveness resembles trials, but intention-to-treat attrition and infection-related mortality are important.
Fixed-duration glofitamab is active after prior BTKi.
Sonrotoclax’s published numerical outcomes are final and unaffected by correction.
Rituximab maintenance benefits older responders after R-CHOP.
Rituximab maintenance added to TRIANGLE’s ibrutinib arms improves PFS without additional risk.
Unadjusted cross-trial response rates establish a preferred sequence among pirtobrutinib, cellular therapy, bispecific antibodies and investigational BCL2 inhibition.
MCL-specific prophylaxis schedules can be derived from these efficacy abstracts.
MCL diagnosis requires a mature B-cell phenotype with cyclin D1 expression and/or CCND1 rearrangement; additional parameters are required for uncommon cyclin D1-negative disease.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text; diagnosis section

claims.atomic_statement: Morphology, Ki-67 and TP53 mutational status should be assessed for risk definition, with TP53 analysis at diagnosis and repeat assessment at relapse where feasible.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text; diagnosis and risk sections

claims.atomic_statement: Selected asymptomatic patients with low-risk or indolent MCL may be observed, with clinical and laboratory review every 3–6 months and imaging as clinically required.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text; indolent presentation section

claims.atomic_statement: After first-line systemic treatment, long-term follow-up should continue, including history, examination and laboratory assessment every 3–6 months initially.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text; follow-up section

claims.atomic_statement: Routine surveillance imaging should be clinically directed, and re-biopsy at relapse is recommended when feasible.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text; diagnosis and follow-up sections

claims.atomic_statement: For a fit adult suitable for dose-intensive treatment, when a first-line covalent BTK-inhibitor pathway is not routinely commissioned, rituximab plus high-dose cytarabine-containing induction followed by ASCT consolidation and 3 years of rituximab maintenance is a guideline-supported conventional pathway.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text plus randomised trial and long-term follow-up abstracts
claims.status: Supported; bundled strategy and local/network protocol confirmation required

claims.atomic_statement: The absence of an NHS England CDF entry does not prove that generic chemotherapy, transplant services or locally commissioned SACT are unfunded.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text and separately controlled NHS England access audit

claims.atomic_statement: For an adult unsuitable for dose-intensive treatment, bendamustine–rituximab is a guideline-supported first-line option, with rituximab maintenance for at least 2 years in responders.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text, mixed-population randomised trial and observational cohorts
claims.status: Supported with qualification; StiL effect is pooled and maintenance-after-BR evidence includes observational data

claims.atomic_statement: For previously untreated MCL unsuitable for transplantation, VR-CAP improves progression-free survival compared with R-CHOP but increases haematological toxicity.

R-BAC may be considered for a carefully selected older patient fit for cytarabine-containing treatment, but it is not established as the default transplant-ineligible regimen and maintenance benefit after R-BAC has not been established.
claims.evidence_location_type: Verified guideline full text and single-arm phase II follow-up abstract

claims.atomic_statement: After first-line ASCT, rituximab 375 mg/m² every 2 months for 3 years improved 4-year EFS, PFS and OS versus observation; prolonged follow-up retained the PFS benefit without a statistically significant OS difference.
claims.evidence_location_type: Randomised phase III and long-term follow-up abstracts
